title: Close out the deletion: retro, and confirm ticfac ran it
description: Run the epic-close retro. Record what this run proved about ticfac driving a real epic on herdr — it is the production run ticfac Phase 3 asks for, and the first orchestration ticks did not perform itself. Then close ticfac's Phase 3 residual for it, and say plainly whether 'extracted' now means extracted.
